name: Zalaújlak (Hungary)
description: Divided diagonally from the upper hoist to the lower fly into a blue upper fly part and a light grey lower hoist part, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Zalaújlak (a white shield with a blue well, a bell and leaves) below the name ZALAÚJLAK in white.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
